text:
maria: quick heads-up — seeing a latency tail regress on L4/A10 for long sequences (seqlen >= 768). p99 went from ~120ms to ~280ms in the canary run. trace points to kernel selector flipping into a small-kv / low-memory kernel under alloc pressure. attaching quick notes.

alex: which build and test command? link to profile?

maria: build: 2026-03-15-1.4.2-rc3 on master. microbench I ran:
```
tools/prof.sh --device l4 --model pythia-6b --seqlen 1024 --batch 2 --kv-mode enabled --iters 50
# outputs: p50=48ms p90=92ms p99=280ms (compare: h100 p99 ~120ms)
```

cheng: saw something similar on A10 last week, seemed like kv cache evictions spiking GC/allocs. do you have the allocator logs / nvtx slices?

maria: snippet from runtime log:
```
[2026-03-15 14:12:09] selector: chose kernel small-kv-v2 (mem_opt) for model pythia-6b seq=1024 batch=2
[2026-03-15 14:12:09] kv_cache: evicting 24 blocks due to alloc_pressure_ratio=0.87
[2026-03-15 14:12:09] kernel_exec: host-sync wait=120ms, compute=58ms, total=280ms
```

toni: cc @perf-bot can we spin an autotune job that includes device_sensitivity param and tracks alloc_pressure_ratio metric? include seqlen buckets [64,256,512,1024] and small-batch pathing. :eyes:

perf-bot: queued autotune job id=autotune-20260316-423, targets=[l4,a10], metrics=[p50,p90,p99,alloc_pressure_ratio], seqlen_buckets=[64,256,512,1024], warmstart=true

ben: quick thought — selector currently picks throughput-optimized kernel when seqlen>512. for small batches (<=4) that hurts latency on L4/A10. propose heuristic: if batch_size<=4 and seqlen>512 prefer latency-optimized kernel variant as fallback.

alex: +1. also we should try warmstarting kernel priors from H100 mappings (best performing kernels on H100 mapped to candidate list on L4/A10) instead of blank slate. map kernel ids instead of blind search to reduce warmup noise.

cheng: I'll draft a per-device preset with fields: kernel_priorities, kv_eviction_threshold, alloc_pressure_ratio_threshold, and fallback_rules. putting draft at presets/per-device/draft-l4-a10-sensitivity-2026-03-16.json in repo.

maria: thanks. I pushed a small repro and a perf trace to the PR. plan: run canary on dedicated-l4 pool tomorrow morning, monitor p99 and alloc_pressure_ratio. action items: cheng -> open PR (preset), toni -> confirm autotune job, ben -> add small-batch heuristic in selector code, alex -> create mapping doc for warmstart. :thumbsup:

alex: also add a regression test that samples ~1k prompts and asserts p99 < 150ms for seqlen in [512,1024] on dedicated-l4 baseline to catch future regressions.

maria: +1. I'll attach the prompt corpus and expected metrics in the PR. thanks everyone.

ben: sounds good. will start a branch for the selector change. :rocket:
